module_summary: Loadable up/down counter wrapper that instantiates cc_delta_counter with a constant delta of one and exposes count and overflow.

anchors.name: q_o
anchors.why: Current count value output from the child delta counter register.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Enables the counter to step by one each cycle.

anchors.name: load_i
anchors.why: Loads d_i into the counter instead of counting.

anchors.name: down_i
anchors.why: Selects count direction: down when set, up otherwise.

anchors.name: d_i
anchors.why: Parallel load value written into the counter on load_i.

anchors.name: overflow_o
anchors.why: Reports counter wrap-around (optionally sticky) from child counter.

groups.name: delta_counter
groups.description: Child up/down delta counter stepping by constant one, with load and overflow.
